newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends firmer against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends firmer against dollar.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka finished stronger at 43.7475/7495 to the dollar in interbank trading on Sunday against the previous close of 43.7485/7495, dealers said.
They said higher call money rates and the closure of major international markets helped the local currency post a marginal gain over the greenback.
The taka opened at 43.7460/7500 per in early trade.
Call money was traded at Saturday's level of nine to 10 percent, dealers said. Friday is the weekend in Moslem Bangladesh.
